## Description and Rationale

I am studying Computer Engineering at Selcuk University and have a strong interest in data, data mining, and aviation analytics. For a previous university data mining project, I chose to classify flight arrival times and draw insights from the resulting patterns. When I discovered that a similar topic was the focus of this challenge, I saw it as a valuable opportunity to build on my previous experience, deepen my knowledge, and test my skills using real-world aviation data. I am also passionate about aviation and hope to pursue a career in this field in the future, which further motivated me to register and participate.

## Details

* Type: Academia
* Country: Turkey
